findings.what: S2A and S2B datatakes on the same relative orbit and day are treated as split granules of one datatake and mixed pixel by pixel in one mosaic
findings.observed: 2026-02-13 R051 30SWG: the two datatakes disagree on SCL in 469,083 of 1,360,375 shared pixels; the mosaic is S2B plus a 22,447 px S2A strip at the swath edge, with a visible seam (zoom_20260213_R051_swathedge.png); the record (0.0958/0.0193) matches neither acquisition
findings.to_pass: group split granules by s2:datatake_id; record each datatake separately or pick one by a stated rule; test with two datatakes on one day
